27021.d: The Lost Grove is an island west of Tirannwn, home to high-level slayer monsters and tree spirits.

gt.heading: Getting there
gt.text:
Before repairing fairy ring BJS (requires five bittercap mushrooms), players can get to the Lost Grove by inspecting the standstone south of the Poison Waste, west of the incandescent wisp colony. Methods for getting there include:
• Use the incandescent wisp colony teleport on the elder divination outfit or the Solak boss portal. 
• Create a group for fighting Solak, Guardian of the Grove and teleport there alone (the minimum player requirement is only one).
• Use the fairy ring code BKP or a ring of duelling to go south of Castle Wars and run west.
• Use the Northern Lost Grove Teleport or its tablet.
• The magic golem head can teleport to the Lost Grove (near the vinecrawlers) if a Shooting Star lands there, once per day. Oddly, it can return the error message "You do not meet the requirements to teleport to where the shooting star has landed." despite there being no requirements to enter The Lost Grove, and the magic golem head may still be able to teleport to there regardless.

Once arriving at the Lost Grove, players may use five bittercap mushrooms on the fairy ring near the middle of the island and then use the code BJS to get there even faster in the future.

27112.d: The Prisoner of Glouphrie is the sixth and penultimate quest in the gnome quest series which involves the continued hunt for Glouphrie.

gt.heading: Reaching Arposandra
gt.text:
After successfully calibrating the anti-illusion device, speak to Golrana and she will offer to take the crystal pieces off your hands and instruct you to meet her back at the Lletya bank. Exit the cave through the ladder and meet her where you originally met with Ilfeen. You must leave the cave using the ladder; if you teleport out, Golrana will not be outside the bank. If you teleport out of the cave, you must re-enter the cave west of the general store and exit via the ladder. Speak to Golrana outside the bank and tell her that you're ready to go on; you will appear next to the sturdy tree east of Lletya.

Start heading eastwards through the forest until Golrana stops you and points your attention to an air vent that the anti-illusion device revealed. Open the vent, and Golrana will hand you a rope to attach to it, allowing you to climb down. Head down the vent. After heading down the vent, you will see a cutscene with a gnome that appears to be Glouphrie training a handful of gnomes who have the ability to create an illusion to conceal themselves. After the cutscene, you will fall through the vent and arrive in a room with a few mining tortoises.

If you are logged out while you are in Arposandra, you may return by climbing the rope in Lletya into the forest and heading back through the vent. To get to the rope squeeze through the fence right next to the entrance to the bank. You can also go to the building immediately north of the bank and go through the north door and then squeeze through the fence as soon as you exit.

27134.d: The Sacred Forge is scenery located in the now-destroyed Hall of Camdozaal.

gt.heading: Getting there
gt.text:
• Use Lassar Teleport to arrive directly on top of Ice Mountain and then enter the trapdoor near the Oracle
• Use a combat bracelet to teleport to Edgeville Monastery then walk south-west to Ice Mountain
• Use a skull sceptre to teleport to Gunnarsgrunn and then walk west to the mountain
• Use the body altar teleport to teleport to the body altar, then walk a short way north-west
• Use Edgeville lodestone teleport and head south-west through the Edgeville Monastery and continue west to Ice Mountain
• Use Falador lodestone teleport and head north-east through the dwarven mine.

27144.d: The Shadow Reef, also known as Ulthven Kreath, is the third Elite Dungeon, a 1-3 player combat/narrative experience that rewards unique loot and Dungeoneering experience and tokens.

gt.heading: Getting there
gt.text:
• Use the Ring of kinship to teleport to Daemonheim, and then run east to the Fremennik ship (Shadow reef)
• Use the boss portal in War's Retreat
• Use the boss portal in the Max Guild (requires 99 in every skill)
• Talk to Bryll Thoksdottir on the bridge west of Al Kharid bank to sail to the Daemonheim coast
• Talk to Bryll Thoksdottir south of the Taverley lodestone to set sail to the Daemonheim coast
• Use a Shadow Reef teleport, which can be purchased from the Daemonheim Rewards shop
• Use the teleport on the treasure chest outside the Dragonkin Laboratory, the Temple of Aminishi, or The Zamorakian Undercity (requires completion of Impressing the Locals)
• Use the dungeoneering cape (requires level 99 dungeoneering) to teleport to Daemonheim woodcutting island dungeon (5), then run north
